title: Generated Asset Provenance
description: Auditable, reproducible record for one asset produced by the governed local generative-asset pipeline (ComfyUI, epic #724). Every file under assets/generated/ MUST have a sibling <id>.provenance.json validating against this schema, and consumer_ref MUST name something that references the asset (anti-LOLLI).

id.description: Stable asset id; the generated file is assets/generated/<id>.png

provider.description: Must be the AIW provider that produced it; matches state/driver/aiw-budget-policy.json

workflow.description: Repo-relative path to the ComfyUI API workflow used

workflow_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the workflow file at generation time (reproducibility)

model.description: Checkpoint / model id used by the workflow

seed.description: Fixed seed — same spec + workflow + seed reproduces the asset

consumer_ref.description: What renders/uses this asset (a repo path, component, or issue ref). Anti-LOLLI: an asset with no live consumer is a violation.

dry_run.description: True when produced by --dry-run (stub image, no GPU); such assets are never committed as real deliverables
